caption: The image is of an embroidered textile featuring two large, stylized plants or trees on a light beige background. On the left, there is a tree with a dark blue trunk and branches, bearing round, yellow fruits and decorated with green and brown leaves. On the right, there is a plant with a similarly colored trunk that branches out into blue and pink-petaled flowers, some of which have yellow tips, and green and brown leaves. In between the two large plants is a smaller, less detailed plant with thin red stems and yellow and pink leaves. The bottom section is bordered by a wavy pattern in shades of dark blue, green, and yellow. Above the central area, the number "1774" is visible, stitched in green thread. In the lower right corner, there is a single small red flower with a yellow center. The embroidery uses a range of colored threads, primarily blues, yellows, greens, reds, browns, and pinks, giving a colorful appearance to the composition.
title: Valance
